stem:
An investor deposited money into an investment account that earns interest compounded annually. The function shown models the amount of money in the account in dollars after t years.

A(t) = 1,550(1.02)^t

Which statement best interprets one value in the function?

options.label: A
options.text: The initial deposit in the investment account was $1,581.

options.label: B
options.text: The amount of money in the investment account increases 102% each year.

options.label: C
options.text: The initial deposit in the investment account was $1,550.

options.label: D
options.text: The amount of money in the investment account decreases 2% each year.
